teaser.en: A coastal Ehretia with clusters of small white flowers, one of four plants the Digo call nchikoma.
teaser.sw: Ehretia ya pwani yenye mafungu ya maua madogo meupe, mmoja wa mimea minne ambayo Wadigo huiita nchikoma.
teaser.dg: Ehretia ya pwani yenye mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru, na ni mmwenga wa mimea mine ambayo Adigo anaiiha nchikoma.

summary.en: Ehretia bakeri is a shrub or small tree of the East African coastal bush. Pakia records it under the Digo name nchikoma, which also covers three other species.
summary.sw: Ehretia bakeri ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki. Pakia anauripoti kwa jina la Kidigo nchikoma, linalojumuisha pia spishi nyingine tatu.
summary.dg: Ehretia bakeri ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni wa pwani ya Afrika ya Mlairo. Pakia anauandika kpwa dzina ra Chidigo nchikoma, ambaro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa aina zanjina tahu.

about.en:
*Ehretia bakeri* is a shrub or small tree with simple, alternate leaves and loose clusters of small white flowers. Like other *Ehretia*, it bears small round fleshy fruits.

It looks much like its cousin *Ehretia amoena*, which the Digo give the same name.
about.sw:
*Ehretia bakeri* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani sahili yanayopishana na mafungu yaliyolegea ya maua madogo meupe. Kama *Ehretia* nyingine, huzaa matunda madogo ya mviringo yenye nyama.

Unafanana sana na binamu yake *Ehretia amoena*, ambao Wadigo huupa jina hilohilo.
about.dg:
*Ehretia bakeri* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide. Chila kodza ni kodza mwenga tu, si makodza madide, na makodza ganamera mwenga-mwenga kpwa kubadilishana uphande. Una mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru garigotawanyika. Dza *Ehretia* zanjina, unavyala matunda madide ga mviringo genye nyama.

Unahalana sana na nduguye *Ehretia amoena*, ambao Adigo anauiha kpwa dzina hiro hiro.

where.en: It belongs to the dry coastal bush and thicket of Kenya and Tanzania. Pakia recorded it among the Digo of the south coast.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia aliuripoti miongoni mwa Wadigo wa pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa weruni na vitsaka vya tsi kavu vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania. Pakia wauandika kahi ya Adigo a pwani ya kusini.

names.en: Pakia records *nchikoma* for this plant, a name also given to *Ehretia amoena*, *Diphasia* sp. A and *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Its meaning is not explained. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *nchikoma* kwa mmea huu, jina ambalo pia hupewa *Ehretia amoena*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Maana yake haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nchikoma* kpwa mmea uhu, dzina ambaro piya nkuhumirwa kpwa *Ehretia amoena*, *Diphasia* sp. A na *Vepris eugeniifolia*. Pakia kalavya manage. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

digo_proposals.note: also given for Diphasia sp. A, Ehretia amoena, Vepris eugeniifolia
